facts.text: A private funicular carries guests from the grand lobby to the slopes.
facts.excerpt: where a private funicular carries guests from the grand lobby to the slopes

facts.text: The hotel's own Deer Hollow trail is steps from the resort, giving ski-in, ski-out access.
facts.excerpt: With our own Deer Hollow trail just steps from the resort, ski-in, ski-out access has never been more inviting.

facts.text: A dedicated Ski Valet team prepares guests' gear.
facts.excerpt: Our dedicated Ski Valet team prepares your gear and ensures a seamless return.

facts.text: The heated split-level infinity pool is open year-round, with adjacent hot tubs.
facts.excerpt: our heated split-level infinity pool invites year-round indulgence. Unwind in adjacent hot tubs

facts.text: The pool and Jacuzzis overlook the Deer Hollow ski run.
facts.excerpt: our heated, split-level, infinity-edge swimming pool and two Jacuzzis overlook the majestic Deer Hollow ski run

facts.text: The St. Regis Spa sits at 8,000 feet and has a heated indoor pool.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Spa spans 14,000 sq ft at 8,000 feet. Eleven treatment rooms, four spa lounges, and a heated indoor pool frame a sanctuary where every treatment begins with a personal consultation.

facts.text: Every spa treatment begins with a personal consultation.
facts.excerpt: a sanctuary where every treatment begins with a personal consultation

facts.text: RIME serves seafood and prime cuts, with drinks from a 10,000-bottle wine cellar.
facts.excerpt: Taste pristinely prepared seafood, sustainably sourced prime cuts and award-winning drinks from a 10,000-bottle wine cellar

facts.text: La Stellina is an Italian restaurant with mosaic floors and black-and-white prints.
facts.excerpt: Mosaic floors and stylish black-and-white prints evoke the streets of Italy.

facts.text: Brasserie 7452 serves classical French comfort food in a light-filled lounge and suits all ages.
facts.excerpt: Savor classical French comfort food in a light-filled lounge. This indulgent Park City restaurant is suitable for all ages.

facts.text: The St. Regis Wine Vault has two adjacent private Wine Vaults for intimate dinners.
facts.excerpt: Two adjacent private Wine Vaults offer superb settings for intimate dinners in Park City, Utah.

facts.text: Butlers perform Champagne sabrage in the lobby each evening at 5:00 pm.
facts.excerpt: Each evening at 5:00 pm in the lobby, our Butlers perform this celebrated ritual, paired with exquisite caviar and Moët Champagne.

facts.text: Complimentary yoga is offered each morning and apres ski is served in the Library each afternoon.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary yoga is offered each morning, and après ski is served in the Library each afternoon.

facts.text: Rooms have electric fireplaces, cable-knit throws, oversized windows and private balconies.
facts.excerpt: warm earth tones, cozy cable-knit throws and electric fireplaces. Oversized windows and private balconies allow guests to marvel at the breathtaking mountain scenery

facts.text: St. Regis Butler Service is available only to guests in the Residences and Suites.
facts.excerpt: Our butler service is exclusively available to guests in our Residences and Suites.

facts.text: The private residences in Snow Park have two to four bedrooms, gourmet kitchens and fireplaces in every room.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in Deer Valley's Snow Park area, our two- to four-bedroom residences offer open floorplan living at its finest — expansive living areas, gourmet kitchens, private balconies, and cozy fireplaces in every room.

facts.text: An inclusive house car runs within Park City limits seven days a week.
facts.excerpt: Our Deer Valley luxury hotel runs an inclusive house car service seven days a week within Park City limits.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle; Salt Lake City International Airport is about 42.6 miles away.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near The St. Regis Deer Valley is Salt Lake City International Airport (SLC). SLC is located approximately 42.6 Miles from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Dogs are welcome, up to two per room and 50 pounds each, with a non-refundable fee per stay.
facts.excerpt: Yes, pets are welcome at The St. Regis Deer Valley. Up to 2 pets are allowed per room. Each pet may weigh up to 50.0 lbs. A non-refundable pet fee of $150.00 per stay applies.

facts.text: Guests must be 18 or older for massages, body treatments and the spa relaxation areas.
facts.excerpt: Guests must be 18 years of age or older to experience a massage, body treatment

facts.text: The hotel has a Topgolf Swing Suite lounge with food and beverage service.
facts.excerpt: Our Park City ski resort hotel features Topgolf Swing Suite, an immersive social experience offering guests a comfy lounge to play and enjoy fantastic food and beverage service.

facts.text: The 12-acre property is in a gated enclave reachable only by private road or ski slope.
facts.excerpt: The 12-acre property is set in a gated enclave that’s accessible only by a private road or ski slope.

facts.text: The ski beach is a terrace with chaise longues and a fire garden.
facts.excerpt: the full-service "ski beach," a 3,000-square-foot terrace with chaise longues and a 40-foot-long fire garden

facts.text: The hotel has five dining venues.
facts.excerpt: Five dining venues, from the mountain-modern cuisine of RIME to the timeless rituals of The St. Regis Bar, await discovery.

facts.text: The hotel has four restaurants.
facts.excerpt: 4 Restaurants

facts.text: The wine cellar holds 13,000 bottles.
facts.excerpt: which houses a decadent 13,000-bottle wine cellar

facts.text: The hotel calls itself the only true ski-in/ski-out Deer Valley hotel.
facts.excerpt: The only true ski-in/ski-out Deer Valley hotel
